item.title: Which Nigerian states got worse, and their deadliest months
item.dc:creator: Batesthommie
item.description: Work in progress — a hierarchical negative-binomial model over Nigeria’s 772 state-LGA cells, fitted on 2015–2025 and scored out of sample on 2026, with gradient boosting kept as a scored control rather than a rival for the headline.
